title: antirrhinum vulgare
intro: Antirrhinum vulgare, commonly known as the Snapdragon or Dragon Flower, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Asia. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum vulgare include its use as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and demulcent, making it effective in treating conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
